items.text: Coconut tree network range reduced; coconut spawns stopped on certain palm trees; coconut tree spawn chance lowered to 25%; apple and beehive spawn chance on oak increased to 25% (from 15%).
Cooking UI now has a separate list for currently craftable items, an “All” button, and category buttons act as toggles, simplifying item selection.
All lighthouses now share a single resource and repair progress bar, so repairing one contributes to all.
Crossbow mesh shading fixed for third‑person view, restoring proper appearance when viewing other players.
Minigun bullets now correctly render when firing near walls, no longer appearing to pass through surfaces.

2026-10-19.summary:
### Resources & Gathering
- Coconut tree network range reduced; coconut spawns stopped on certain palm trees; coconut tree spawn chance lowered to 25%; apple and beehive spawn chance on oak increased to 25% (from 15%).

### Cooking UI
- Cooking UI now has a separate list for currently craftable items, an “All” button, and category buttons act as toggles, simplifying item selection.

### Monuments
- All lighthouses now share a single resource and repair progress bar, so repairing one contributes to all.

### Visual & Gameplay Fixes
- Crossbow mesh shading fixed for third‑person view, restoring proper appearance when viewing other players.
- Minigun bullets now correctly render when firing near walls, no longer appearing to pass through surfaces.

items.text: Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.
Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.
Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

2026-10-18.summary:
### Combat Audio
- Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.

### Farming & UI
- Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.

### Vehicle & Animal Transport
- Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

items.text: Fixed attached grenades sometimes not appearing until a later animation event, ensuring grenades are visible immediately when thrown or equipped.
Improved Warhead Garage Door movement precision and updated its prefab, making the door’s busy colliders more accurate and fixing related LOD issues.
Added shared dead and flee states to livestock FSMs, improving how cows, sheep, and other critters react to threats and repellents.
Fixed a bug where joining a server with C+S would reset custom server convars (like gamemode settings) to defaults.
Fixed scarecrow error that could prevent scarecrows from spawning correctly during the Halloween 2026 update.

2026-10-16.summary:
### Combat & Explosives
- Fixed attached grenades sometimes not appearing until a later animation event, ensuring grenades are visible immediately when thrown or equipped.

### Base & Doors
- Improved Warhead Garage Door movement precision and updated its prefab, making the door’s busy colliders more accurate and fixing related LOD issues.

### Animals & AI
- Added shared dead and flee states to livestock FSMs, improving how cows, sheep, and other critters react to threats and repellents.

### Server & Settings
- Fixed a bug where joining a server with C+S would reset custom server convars (like gamemode settings) to defaults.

### Monuments
- Fixed scarecrow error that could prevent scarecrows from spawning correctly during the Halloween 2026 update.
